body:
Chief hold accepted on cand-3B6Y9A0XKDK0NK7PMCMVZNH5SZ. I independently measured: HEAD is main at d147b596; recorded base e0c884ba is not an ancestor of main; merge-base(main, c71df910) is e584ad6d. Diff vs recorded base is the two policy paths. Diff vs that merge-base is six Sherlock files (README, alias-map, annotation-lineage, recall-lineage, source-manifest, timebase-repair). Policy/review still name only the two. Landability now reports landable=true with empty reason_codes; that does not license landing.

My APPROVE was of the two-path parent delta only. I will not land, authorize, or carry that verdict onto a six-path successor. Fresh review starts only if I am named on a new candidate.
